limitations: The candidate emits 11 blocks / 15 edges, exactly the section 21 count for retail.
The depth is re-read from 0x00AFA7E0 after the indirect handler call, which retail does at 0x0048874B; caching it would pop the wrong slot when a handler pushes or pops the stack.
The child-validity test reproduces retail's mov/neg/sbb/and sequence: the child is pushed only when its first word is non-zero.
The handler is called with one word, matching the phase-1 dispatch shape that section 21 derived from the real call sites; the phase-0 table is the two-word caller and is a different site.
Runtime unobserved; reachable only through the startup sequence behind the 0x00402930 boundary.
